question: Choose the antonym of ‘enhance’:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Diminish)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enhance"** means to increase or improve the quality, value, or extent of something. (बढ़ाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company implemented new strategies to enhance employee productivity.
 
 
 
• **"Diminish"** is the opposite of enhance and means to reduce, decrease, or make something seem less important. (घटाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The impact of the changes diminished over time as people adjusted to them.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'enhance'** is **'diminish'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Diminish)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Increase** (बढ़ाना): To become or make something greater in size, amount, or number.

 
 
• **Example:** The population of the city has significantly increased over the past decade.
 
 
 
• **Enlarge** (विस्तार करना): To make something bigger in size or scale.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist decided to enlarge the painting to showcase more details.
 
 
 
• **Augment** (वृद्धि करना): To make something greater by adding to it; to increase.
 
 
• **Example:** She augmented her income by taking on freelance projects.
